chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad ibn Isa, from Rabi', from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

By Allah, no one from the Arabs or the non-Arabs loves us except the people of noble houses, honor, and lineage; and no one from these and those hates us except every person of impurity of illegitimate origin.
ai.seo_question: Who loves and who hates the Ahl al-Bayt according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) draws a sharp distinction between the nobility of lineage (sharaf) and the purity of origin (ma'din), asserting that true love for the Ahl al-Bayt is reserved for those of noble character among both Arabs and non-Arabs. Conversely, he identifies the haters as 'danas' (impurity or illegitimacy), a term often interpreted in Shia exegesis as referring to those lacking spiritual or genealogical purity, thereby linking social status with spiritual merit. This highlights the Shia emphasis on intrinsic worth and divine selection over mere tribal affiliation.

en.hubeali: H 14945 – Ali Bin Ibrahiim, from his father, from Hammaad Bin Isa, from Rabi’e, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws has said;

‘By Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! No one from the Arabs or the non-Arabs loves us<sup>asws</sup> except the people of noble houses, and the (noble) origins; and no one from these ones and those ones hates us<sup>asws</sup> except for all the filthy ones and of illegitimate origin’.
en.sarwar: 498. Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Khalid, and Al-Husayn Bin Sa’d, from Al-Nazar Bin Suweyd, from Yahya Al-Halby, from Haroun Bin Kharjat, from Abu Baseer, who has narrated the following: Abu Ja’far (a.s.) regarding the Statement of Allah (azwj) Mighty and Majestic: “[2:247] And their prophet said to them: Surely Allah has raised Talut to be a king over you. He (a.s.) said: ‘He (as) was neither from the grandsons of the Prophets (as) nor was he (as) from the grandsons of the kings’. He said: Surely Allah has chosen him in preference to you”. And Said: “[2:248] And the prophet said to them: Surely the sign of His kingdom is, that there shall come to you the chest in which there is tranquillity from your Lord and residue of the relics of what the children of Musa and the children of Haroun have left, the angels bearing it”.

And Allah (azwj) Said: “[2:249] Surely Allah will try you with a river; whoever then drinks from it, he is not of me, and whoever does not taste of it, he is surely of me, So they drank from it except for three hundred and thirteen men. From them were those who drank, and those who did not drink. So when it was time for duel, the ones who had drunk they said: We have today no power against Jalut and his forces. And those who did not drink said: How often has a small party vanquished a numerous host by Allah’s permission, and Allah is with the patient”.
